summary: RenX Enterprises Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a tranched private placement of Senior Convertible Notes and warrants to institutional investors, first entered into on April 30, 2026. Initial closing on May 4, 2026 involved $6.3M notes and warrants for ~3.92M shares; second closing of $6.7M notes and ~4.17M warrants awaits registration effectiveness. The filing also covers up to $87M in additional notes and ~54.09M warrants subject to mutual consent. This is a financing transaction, not a special situation; no change-of-control, tender offer, or strategic review is implicated.
